author: GameTrailers
description:
Kingdom III: Rising Realms is an atmospheric sidescroller, base-building, and micro-strategy game. Players will set out on a grand adventure in a shattered medieval-inspired world to reclaim their fallen Kingdom, protect their crown, and defeat the monstrous Greed and their ruler—The Greed King. 
Kingdom III: Rising Realms will launch on XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC and XBOX Cloud, PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Kingdom 3: Rising Realms - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Rivage invites players to take on the role of Miranda as she searches for answers about her crew’s disappearance and strives to escape a reality-bending cosmic phenomenon. Set aboard a meticulously detailed and interactable space station in the 25th century, players must solve intricate puzzles to reveal the truth behind the distortions that have consumed the station. 
Rivage will launch on September 22, 2026, on PC via Steam.
title: Rivage - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Escape From Playtime announcement trailer for this upcoming 1-4 online co-op survival horror game set in the Poppy Playtime universe. In this 1-4 player online co-op game, players are sent back into the infamous Playtime Co. factory from the perspective of the cute-yet-disturbing Smiling Critters. Tasked with scavenging materials for a mysterious building project that promises escape from the factory, players will need to work together and follow instructions from an ominous voice lurking somewhere in the shadows, all while evading the factory’s most dangerous denizens. 

Escape From Playtime will be available on PC via Steam.
title: Escape from Playtime - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about your duties on a strange flight in this Night Plane announcement trailer for the upcoming job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem. Night Plane will be available on PC (via Steam) in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Night Plane - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Version 1.0 of Volkolak: The Will of Gods is out now on Steam. Watch the Volkolak: The Will of Gods version 1.0 launch trailer for this 2D soulsvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting, with hand-drawn animation. Explore an enchanted world full of secrets and enemies. Your choices will lead to several endings: become a warrior, a werewolf, or join the darkness.
title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.
Sweetheart launches on Steam via PC , PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch next year.
title: Sweetheart - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
We Are So Cooked launches on Windows PC (via Steam) on October 15, 2026, and later on Nintendo Switch 1|2, PlayStation 5, and XBOX Series X|S. Wishlist the game now.
title: We Are So Cooked - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a peek at classes, combat, enemies, and more in this Amphibian announcement trailer for the upcoming story-driven, frog-based, Super2D RPG. Amphibian will be available on PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2028.

A countrywide drought forces Sapo and his frog allies into war against the invading toads. As dehydration and starvation grip The Pond, they must hurry to find a solution to the crisis - and liberate their homeland. Dive into a focused, concise experience with fully curated battles and no random encounters, inspired by classic, turn-based RPGs from the era of GameCube and Game Boy Advance.
title: Amphibian - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: To hoard is to possess, to possess is to control. What hope do you have in controlling the truth? Check out the latest Hoarder trailer for the upcoming adventure game from the co-creator of Darkwood. What starts as a mundane cleaning simulator slowly spirals into a submerged nightmare. Pilot a submarine to salvage the abyss by day and uncover the secrets of your new home by night. Hoarder will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Hoarder - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Pawtential Disaster, a physics-based co-op game developed by Yummy Games. Players will embody a duo of dogs to carefully lead a baby in a sled back to their home. Overcome dangerous obstacles, deal with the physics, and ensure the baby's safety. Pawtential Disaster is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Pawtential Disaster - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Starforged Legacy trailer to see what to expect with the Hangar & Arsenal update, which brings the Combat Circuit, a 12-sector mode focused on a fast-paced fight, extract, and shop loop. It also features new weapons and new ships to the sci-fi action roguelike bullet hell game. Starforged Legacy is out now in Steam Early Access, and the Hangar & Arsenal update is out now.
title: Starforged Legacy - Official Hangar & Arsenal Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer for Haunted Paws, a cozy co-op horror game developed by LazyFlock. Players will embark on a thrilling adventure as two Puppies on a quest to save their human friend from a haunted mansion. Uncover secrets, take on sinister creatures, and customize a puppy in Haunted Paws, coming soon to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Haunted Paws - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for The Doi, a co-op puzzle platformer developed by North Peak Studio. Players will work together to progress through an array of levels, overcome difficult platforming obstacles, and indulge in unexpected game moments in the process. The Doi is coming soon to macOS, Linux, and PC (Steam).
title: The Doi - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Tidy Town is a third-person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart. Watch the Tidy Town announcement trailer to see its cute world, gameplay, and more. Tidy Town will be available on PC.
title: Tidy Town - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the announcement trailer for Cat Customs Simulator, an upcoming cozy inspection game where you are the customs officer responsible for deciding which cats can cross the border. Cat Customs Simulator will be available on PC.
title: Cat Customs Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Wing Gundam Zero is coming to Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2. Watch the latest Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2 trailer for the free-to-play action game to see what to expect. Take your Mobile Suits into battle, outfit them with equipment to match your playstyle, and level them up to unlock their full potential. Wing Gundam Zero will be available in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2 on September 2, 2026 (at 10 PM PT).
title: Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2 - Official Wing Gundam Zero Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take the conn, Captain. Deck & Conn is available now on Steam. Watch the Deck & Conn launch trailer for this turn-based space tactics game. Set in a future imagined through the technology of 1989, Deck & Conn places players in command of a nuclear-powered corvette fighting an ongoing war among the stars. Interpret coded orders, investigate unidentified contacts, allocate limited power, manage the vessel’s interconnected systems, and make tactical decisions through an array of retro terminals and instruments.
title: Deck & Conn - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for LEGO Harry Potter Collection, a collection of the hit action-adventure LEGO games developed by TT Games and Warner Bros. Games. Players will explore the trials, tribulations, and the great halls of Hogwarts across the Wizarding World on the go with the Nintendo Switch 2. The collection is packed with LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4, LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7, and all of the released DLC packs with new characters to play as. The LEGO Harry Potter Collection is launching on October 16 for Nintendo Switch 2.
title: LEGO Harry Potter Collection - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Fallout 76 creative director Jon Rush and senior community manager Richard Stanford for a breakdown of what you can expect from The Slasher update coming to Fallout 76. Additionally, check out what's coming with Season 26: Beware the Blood Moon. In Season 26, you can rack up S.C.O.R.E, earn tickets, and redeem them for in-game rewards, available for a limited time. The Slasher update and Season 26 of Fallout 76 arrive on September 15, 2026.

Could it be...has The Pint-Sized Slasher returned? Gather your gang and dig up some clues (and even some graves along the way) as you uncover the culprit behind a spree of grisly crimes gripping Appalachia in fear!
title: Fallout 76: The Slasher - Official Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Talaka, a 2D action roguelite developed by Potato Kid. Players will slash, shoot, and slice enemies across a hand-drawn adventure to restore myths across a suite of different levels. Keep chaos from asserting its domain in Talaka, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Talaka - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Rebounder announcement trailer for this upcoming precision platformer game from developer ThirtyThree and publisher Aggro Crab. Nail the run. Deliver your line. Rebounder is a hand-crafted precision platformer about a roughneck worker recruited for a hazardous job on a distant planet. A tough-but-fair gauntlet set in a surreal comic-book world of ink, paper, and print. Rebounder will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.
title: Rebounder - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Crimson Moon, a third-person action RPG developed by ProbablyMonsters. Players will take on demon after demon with intense, melee-based combat alone or with a friend in co-op. Fulfill the destined prophecy in Crimson Moon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Crimson Moon - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the East Haddonfield Map Reveal Trailer for Halloween: The Game, the upcoming asymmetrical action horror game developed by Illfonic. Players can get an in-depth look at East Haddonfield, a map that marks Michael's first stop after escaping Smith Grove Sanitarium. Study the desolate streets and eerie locales of East Haddonfield in Halloween: The Game, launching on September 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Halloween: The Game - Official East Haddonfield Map Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest gets a new trailer and a release date. Watch the Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest release date trailer for this upcoming action-adventure game set in the imaginative world of the beloved book series. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest features four new storylines written exclusively for the game by author Erin Hunter. Forge your destiny, defend your clan and become a true Warrior Cat! Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store on October 23, 2026.

In Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest, choose between a multitude of unique customization options to create your own warrior purr-fectly suited for the journey ahead. Choose your Clan, forge bonds with allies, rise through the ranks, and defend your home in strategic turn-based combat. Each Clan has its own unique story campaign built upon their culture and traditions.
title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Pre-Order Trailer for Hot Wheels Infinite Rush, an arcade racing game developed by Milestone. Players will take to the track in a whole new Hot Wheels island filled with new events, challenges, and thrilling courses. Race with legendary vehicles in Hot Wheels Infinite Rush, launching on September 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush - Official Pre-Order Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the DLSS 4.5 Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Like or Die, a team-based survival first-person shooter developed by NCSoft. Players can take on the opposition of streamers in next-level fidelity with DLSS 4.5 implementation courtesy of NVIDIA technology on PC. Duke it out in Like or Die, coming soon to PC (Steam).

Source: https://youtube.com/nvidia
title: Like or Die - Official DLSS 4.5 Gameplay Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham, an upcoming dark supernatural mystery game. The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham, a desert-noir detective adventure inspired by the surreal works of David Lynch, the music of Lord Huron, and the stylings of strange fiction, tells the story of Lilith who finds herself at the center of a supernatural mystery involving mass vanishings. Following an alarming voicemail from her estranged daughter, Lilith is thrust into a tangled web of deceit involving the eerie Alpine Movie Manor Hotel and Drive-In (based on a real attraction in Colorado’s San Luis Valley). 

The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham will be available on PC via Steam in 2027.
title: The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Awaken the true spirit of a hero. Get another look at combat, characters, and more from Metaphor: ReFantazio in this trailer for the RPG. Metaphor: ReFantazio will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, 2026. It is also already available on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.
title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Check out the latest Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 trailer for this upcoming job sim sequel. Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 23, 2026.

Begin a whole new career in the world of lawncare, using a range of licensed, real-world equipment to go with the mow in a relaxing and rewarding business sim. Take on assignments across the USA, from suburban lawn mowing tasks to commercial groundskeeping jobs, and run your business from the new fully-explorable HQ, where players can set up contracts, hire employees, and maintain and expand their fleet of equipment.
title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Your stories now have a place in the Zone. Watch the latest STALKER 2 trailer to see what you can expect with the Zone Kit Phase 2, which expands the possibilities of STALKER 2 modding with narrative scripting, audio, localization, and mod data saving. With the Zone Kit Phase 2, you can build your own stories or rewrite existing ones, give its characters a voice, bring it to players in different languages, and turn it into a complete experience within the Zone. Zone Kit is available for free on the Epic Games Store.

#Stalker2 #Gaming #IGN
title: STALKER 2 - Official Zone Kit Phase 2 Modding Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the Online mode of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve in this latest trailer for the upcoming flight action game. Learn about Online mode and what to expect from this independent game mode, which features its own progression and save separate from Ace Combat 8's campaign mode. The new trailer details character customization, the airbase player hub, co-op assault and co-op warfare modes, and more. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 2, 2026.

#AceCombat8WingsOfTheve #Gaming #IGN
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Online 101 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Reveal Trailer for Temporal Urgency, a first-person exploration psychological horror game developed by Grand Forge Games. Players will make use of Time itself as Viktor Andrews to solve puzzles, explore the bounds of the present moment into the past and future, and uncover a deep truth that questions reality itself. Temporal Urgency is coming soon to PC (Steam). 

#TemporalUrgency #Gaming #IGN
title: Temporal Urgency - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Join Thomas Mahler of Moon Studios for an update regarding the new release date for version 1.0 of No Rest for the Wicked in this latest video for the soulslike action RPG. No Rest for the Wicked is currently available to buy on PC via Steam Early Access. No Rest for the Wicked will be available on PC and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in March 2027, with release dates for the Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2 versions to be determined.
title: No Rest for the Wicked - Official 1.0 Delay Announcement Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for WheelMates, a co-op driving RC adventure game developed by Firevolt. Players will traverse a professor's property from the perspective of an RC car to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and attain new gadgets to progress. WheelMates is available now for PC (Steam).
title: WheelMates - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the Swordplay Action Trailer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword, the upcoming installment to the hit third-person action game developed by Capcom. Players will get an overview of the journey that lies ahead, from key locations, combat techniques, and powerful Oni abilities to take on the powerful bosses with ease. Onimusha: Way of the Sword is launching on September 4 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, Xbox on PC, and Epic Games Store).

#OnimiushaWayOfTheSword #Gaming #IGN
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Swordplay Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Your only hope is each other. Watch the latest Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars trailer to see gameplay and what to expect from this upcoming mixed reality game. Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars will feature an entirely new, original chapter developed in collaboration with Andy Weir specifically for the game. Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars will be available on Meta Quest, PICO, and Android XR.

Step into the role of Ryland Grace in an original chapter of the Hail Mary mission, experiencing humanity’s last hope firsthand as deep space grows increasingly uncertain around them. As this mixed-reality experience blends your own physical environment with the Hail Mary itself, you’ll diagnose problems, improvise solutions and push the limits of science and engineering to keep the mission alive.

#ProjectHailMary #Gaming #IGN
title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The final update for Everspace 2 brings Steam Deck verification and console optimization. Watch the latest Everspace 2 trailer for a closer look at what you can expect from the final update. The free technical update brings optimizations, community-requested bug fixes, and minor features to all versions of Everspace 2. Everspace 2's final technical update is out now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Everspace 2 - Official Final Technical Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing announcement trailer for this upcoming single-player combat sports game set in the dark underbelly of late-1990s illegal fighting. Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Itch.io) on November 4, 2026. It will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.
title: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Monster in the Mansion announcement trailer for this multiplayer, asymmetrical survival horror game launching on Roblox. In this game of cat and mouse, eight players enter, one is possessed by the monster and hunts everyone down. Meanwhile, the rest of the players must search the mansion for the hidden books to craft an antidote and cure the monster before it's too late! Monster in the Mansion will be available on Roblox in Early Access in September 2026. You can learn more about Monster in the Mansion here if you're interested: www.monsterinthemansion.com
title: Monster in the Mansion - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Yuriri Naka (voice of the Oni Lady) as she introduces you to Dokyo in this latest Onimusha: Way of the Sword trailer for the upcoming action game. Dokyo is an unusual entity that spends much of her time in her laboratory under the capital, engrossed in creating new Genma variants. One glimpse at the facility's eerie nature is enough to make clear her twisted tastes. 

Onimusha: Way of the Sword plunges the Oni Gauntlet-wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi, into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. 

Onimusha: Way of the Sword will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on September 4, 2026. A demo is out now.

#OnimushaWayOfTheSword #Gaming #IGN
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Dokyo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join game director Andreas Bonnardel, game design director Marco Mele, and narrative director Sarah Beaulieu from developer Old Skull Games, along with consultant Nels Anderson (former Mark of the Ninja lead designer), for a deep dive into the stealth-combat gameplay of Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster in this latest video for the upcoming 2D stealth-action platformer game. The team discusses the story, world, and insights into building the stealth gameplay of Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster. In Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster, play as a sneaky ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster. 

Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.
title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join the development team at Black Deer Games for a deep dive into the gameplay of Hordeguard: Winds of the North in this trailer for the upcoming tower defense game featuring RPG and strategy elements. Learn about your objectives, strategies, combat, various hero abilities, upgrades, building uses, and much more in this gameplay breakdown. Hordeguard: Winds of the North will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618000/Hordeguard_Winds_of_the_North/

In Hordeguard: Winds of the North, leap into the heart of a Viking fantasy siege where tower defense meets action combat, strategy, and co-op survival. Gather what you can, raise your defenses, fight beside your friends, and hold the line against an unending horde.
title: Hordeguard: Winds of the North - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Stream Train, a co-op horror adventure game developed by Half Past Yellow. Players will take a spooky route in the Uncanny Vallet while livestreaming with up to six players. Stand face-to-face with monsters, listen to the chat's requests, and go scarily viral. Stream Train is launching on October 15 for PC (Steam).
title: Stream Train - Official Release Date Trailer
